payout_quote: To qualify for $200 bonus, you must: 1. Open a Consumer Checking Account 2. Within 60 days of account opening, establish recurring direct deposit(s) with a combined total of $1,000 or more per month 3. Have an account balance of $500 or more on the 60th day after the account is opened
steps: Join Arizona Financial Credit Union and open a new Consumer Checking account online, presenting a valid promotional code at account opening ($20 minimum opening deposit; Free Checking has no monthly service fees).

For the $200 tier: within 60 days of account opening, establish recurring direct deposit(s) totaling $1,000 or more per month — electronic deposit of paycheck, pension, or government benefits from an employer or government agency (Zelle, Venmo, PayPal do not count).
Have an account balance of $500 or more on the 60th day after the account is opened.

For lesser amounts, either: $150 tier — $500+/month recurring DD or $250+/month DD + 15 debit transactions within 60 days plus a $250+ balance on day 60; $100 tier — 15 debit card transactions within 60 days.
Keep the account in good standing for 6 months (early closure within 6 months means the bonus is deducted at closing); the bonus is deposited ~75 days after account opening.
catches: Top $200 tier requires BOTH recurring ACH direct deposits of $1,000+/month (paycheck, pension, government benefits — Zelle/Venmo/PayPal excluded) established within 60 days AND a $500+ balance on the 60th day after opening.
Lesser tiers: $150 (either $500/mo DD or $250/mo DD + 15 debit transactions, plus $250 balance on day 60) or $100 (15 debit card transactions within 60 days).

Eligibility: 18+, brand-new member with no existing primary relationships; former members qualify only if accounts were closed 12+ months prior; a valid promotional code must be presented at account opening.
Closing the checking account within 6 months of opening causes the bonus amount to be deducted at closing (early-closure clawback).
All bonuses are taxable income, reported on IRS Form 1099-MISC. Offer may expire or change at any time (no stated end date — act while live).
No monthly service fees on Free Checking, but other standard fees (overdraft, stop payments, out-of-network ATMs) can reduce earnings.
biggest_catch: Two hurdles together: a recurring $1,000/month ACH direct deposit (P2P apps don't count) AND a $500 balance sitting in the account on day 60; miss either and you drop to a $150 or $100 tier — and the account can't be closed for 6 months without losing the bonus.
